claim: PLAIN: Dhruv's ideal Trotter step is built from 12 copies of the same little 3-qubit "hopping" operation (each needs exactly 4 entangling MS gates to be perfect) plus 6 tiny 2-qubit ones. The incumbent hits 54 MS at essentially perfect fidelity (~1e-13), but the scorer only requires infidelity <= 1e-4 -- roughly ten billion times looser. The bet: the 4th MS gate in a hopping block might carry so little weight that dropping it (using a 3-MS approximation) barely dents fidelity. If the best 3-MS fit of one hopping block has mean infidelity r, then because block errors add roughly linearly, we can afford to prune k = floor(5e-5 / r) of the 12 hopping blocks from 4->3 MS and still stay under the 1e-4 bar, giving a certified circuit of (54 - k) MS -- strictly below his hand-designed 9N=54 (the STRETCH). FORMAL: replace k of the 12 identical 4-MS hopping-block subcircuits with the 3-MS best fit of HOP_UNITARY; on-site blocks stay at 1 MS each; certify the assembled 18-qubit circuit's state-averaged mean infidelity vs U_ideal <= 1e-4 with margin. This is approximate pruning below the exact per-block minimum (Director lane 4), NOT a per-block re-min (that was EXP-0001).
prediction: Score = 54 - k, k = floor(5e-5 / r) where r = mean infidelity of the best 3-MS fit of the canonical hopping block. HONEST distribution: I expect the 4th MS to be load-bearing at this coupling (-4J*dt = 1.2 rad), so most likely r ~ 1e-3..1e-2 => k=0 => NO promotion (score stays 54), which certifies that his 9N=54 is tight even at the loosened 1e-4 bar (the honest-null the Director wants). I assign <30% to r <= 5e-5; if it fires, score lands in 53..42 MS -- a genuine certified beat of his hand-design. I register this because ONE fit_block call decisively resolves the cheapest remaining below-54 question, with strongly asymmetric payoff.
falsifier: fit_block(HOP_UNITARY, hop_qubits(b), n_ms=3) best mean infidelity r > 5e-5, so floor(5e-5 / r) = 0 -> cannot prune even one hopping block within the fidelity budget -> no valid circuit below 54 via this lane. OR: with k>=1 pruned blocks, the assembled full-circuit estimate_infidelity on my own random states exceeds 1e-4 (block errors aggregate worse than first-order-additive) -> refuted.
kill_threshold: If r > 5e-5 (k=0), OR every k>=1 assembled circuit fails estimate_infidelity <= 1e-4, this lane is DEAD: per-block 3-MS approximate pruning cannot beat 54 at the fidelity bar. Accept it and record the honest-null evidence that 54 MS is tight even with 1e-4 of allowed slack. Do NOT retry per-block pruning without the priced reopen condition.
brief:
Edit ONLY workspace/candidate.py. It must define build_circuit() -> list of native-gate tuples, be SELF-CONTAINED (scored as a copy in experiments/ where target/baseline/incumbent are NOT importable; numpy allowed), and freeze final numeric gate tuples. Derive the circuit in a dev/__main__ scratch that imports target, then hardcode the resulting gate list into build_circuit and remove the scratch.

STEP 1 -- read the order. Read workspace/target.py and determine the EXACT order in which ideal_step applies the 12 hopping blocks (hop_qubits(b), b in 0..11) and 6 on-site blocks (int_qubits(i), i in 0..5). Fidelity depends on this order; assemble candidate in the identical order. This is the ONLY place order matters -- get it exactly.

STEP 2 -- measure r. Call fit_block(HOP_UNITARY, hop_qubits(0), n_ms=3); read its native sub-circuit AND its residual mean infidelity r (compute r explicitly if fit_block returns only the circuit: r = estimate_infidelity of a circuit that is JUST this 3-MS block vs a target that is JUST HOP_UNITARY on those qubits, or use fit_block's reported residual). Record r.

STEP 3 -- choose k. k = min(12, floor(5e-5 / r)). (5e-5, not 1e-4, leaves margin for self-state vs hidden-battery differences.) If k == 0: the hypothesis is falsified; produce build_circuit() equal to the valid 54-MS incumbent (all 12 hopping at 4 MS, all 6 on-site at 1 MS) so the scorer records a clean no-promotion, and print r in the scratch output for the ledger. Stop.

STEP 4 -- assemble (k >= 1). Build the full native gate list in the target order: for the k chosen hopping blocks (any k of the 12; they are identical up to relabelling) use fit_block(HOP_UNITARY, hop_qubits(b), n_ms=3); for the remaining 12-k hopping blocks use fit_block(HOP_UNITARY, hop_qubits(b), n_ms=4); for each on-site block use fit_block(INT_UNITARY, int_qubits(i), n_ms=1). Concatenate in the exact ideal_step order.

STEP 5 -- certify on YOUR OWN states (never touch scorekeeper_private, never optimize toward a specific input distribution or noise realization -- certify vs U_ideal only). Confirm: is_native(circuit) is True; ms_count(circuit) == 54 - k; estimate_infidelity(circuit) <= 1e-4 with target <= 5e-5, evaluated on >= 256 states spanning Haar/random-product/computational-basis. If it fails the bar at this k, decrement k by 1 and re-verify; the largest k that certifies <= 5e-5 wins.

STEP 6 -- freeze. Hardcode the final gate tuples (plain floats) into a self-contained build_circuit(); ensure no import of target/baseline/incumbent remains in candidate.py.
done_definition: workspace/candidate.py defines a self-contained build_circuit() returning a native-gate tuple list with: is_native True; ms_count == 54 - k; estimate_infidelity <= 1e-4 (verified <= 5e-5 on >= 256 mixed random states); no import of target/baseline/incumbent. For a promotion, k >= 1 (ms_count <= 53). If the measured 3-MS residual r forces k == 0, build_circuit() equals the valid 54-MS incumbent and the scratch output reports r (recorded refutation, no promotion).
reopen_condition: If refuted (r > 5e-5, k=0), the below-54 direction reopens ONLY when a WHOLE-CIRCUIT (not per-block) angle optimizer over a fixed 53-MS native ansatz demonstrates, in an offline probe on my own random states, mean infidelity <= 1e-4 -- i.e., neighboring blocks' free angles can COMPENSATE one hopping block's missing 4th MS (something per-block pruning structurally cannot do). Priced: requires implementing an 18-qubit statevector angle optimization (scipy L-BFGS over the native gate angles of the 53-MS ansatz), ~1 coder cycle. Retry only if such a probe shows <= 1e-4 is feasible at 53 MS.
